title: Structuring packages in a complex Java project
answer: Structure packages around cohesive responsibilities and dependency direction rather than arbitrary file counts. AeroTopo uses a feature/domain-oriented root with separate packages for `api`, `config`, `domain`, `gis`, `io`, `ops`, `persistence`, `service`, and `learning`. `ProjectService` depends on domain, GIS, persistence, and configuration boundaries. A maintainable structure keeps domain concepts discoverable, prevents cyclic dependencies, avoids giant `util` packages, and makes architectural ownership understandable.
